calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::BinaryOperatorParameterName registers an offense and corrects for `#+` when argument is not named other
calls.source: def +(foo); end
messages: When defining the `+` operator, name its argument `other`.
calls.correction: def +(other); end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::BinaryOperatorParameterName works properly even if the argument not surrounded with braces
calls.source:

messages: When defining the `+` operator, name its argument `other`.
calls.correction:

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::BinaryOperatorParameterName registers an offense and corrects when argument is referenced in method body
calls.source:
def +(arg)
  lvar = 'lvar'
  do_something(arg, lvar)
end
messages: When defining the `+` operator, name its argument `other`.
calls.correction:
def +(other)
  lvar = 'lvar'
  do_something(other, lvar)
end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::BinaryOperatorParameterName does not rename a reference to a block parameter that shadows the operator argument
calls.source:
def +(foo)
  result = foo
  [1, 2, 3].each do |foo|
    result += foo
  end
  result
end
messages: When defining the `+` operator, name its argument `other`.
calls.correction:
def +(other)
  result = other
  [1, 2, 3].each do |foo|
    result += foo
  end
  result
end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::RescuedExceptionsVariableName with default config when the variable is reassigned only corrects uses of the exception
calls.source:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => error
  error = {
    error_message: error.message
  }
  puts error
end
calls.correction:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => e
  error = {
    error_message: e.message
  }
  puts error
end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::RescuedExceptionsVariableName with default config when the variable is reassigned only corrects the exception variable
calls.source:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => error
  message = error.message
  puts message
end
calls.correction:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => e
  message = e.message
  puts message
end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::RescuedExceptionsVariableName with default config when the variable is reassigned corrects only up to the reassignment, leaving later references untouched
calls.source:
begin
  do_something
rescue StandardError => error
  error = build_message(error)
end
puts error
calls.correction:
begin
  do_something
rescue StandardError => e
  error = build_message(e)
end
puts error

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::RescuedExceptionsVariableName with default config when the variable is reassigned using multiple assignment only corrects uses of the exception
calls.source:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => error
  error, foo = 1, error
  puts error
end
calls.correction:
def main
  raise
rescue StandardError => e
  error, foo = 1, e
  puts error
end

calls.description: RuboCop::Cop::Naming::RescuedExceptionsVariableName with default config with nested rescues handles it
calls.source:
begin
rescue StandardError => e1
  begin
    log(e1)
  rescue StandardError => e2
    log(e1, e2)
  end
end
calls.correction:
begin
rescue StandardError => e
  begin
    log(e)
  rescue StandardError => e2
    log(e, e2)
  end
end
